title: 利率油价双升：科技板块承压，超1%跌幅后市场如何反应？
speaker: Hilton Chang

segments.en: You're not really seeing that offset from the micro story given that second quarter earnings were basically behind us.
segments.zh: 由于二季度财报季基本结束，微观层面的利好并未真正抵消宏观压力。

segments.en: So you're not really getting the earnings side of things that really is helping or offsetting some of the moves that we're seeing right now.
segments.zh: 因此，盈利端并未真正帮助或抵消当前的市场波动。

segments.en: So there you are seeing more pressure on equities here today.
segments.zh: 所以今天权益市场面临更大压力。

segments.en: It's given what we've been seeing with rising rates, rising oil, stocks, especially the tech sector taking the brunt of it in terms of the pain here.
segments.zh: 鉴于利率和油价上升，科技板块首当其冲，承受了大部分压力。

segments.en: Chinex and star 50 are seeing losses of more than 1%.
